GitHub issue #47: Lock

Design and Develop with Algorithms and logarthems  Groks own app lock. name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  android:
    name: Android Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: android
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v3
      - name: Run tests
        run:./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --stacktrace
      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: android-test-results
          path: android/build/test-results/testDebugUnitTest/

  ios:
    name: iOS Unit Tests
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Select Xcode
        run: sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode_15.4.app
      - name: Install CocoaPods
        run: |
          cd example/ios
          pod install
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          xcodebuild test \
            -workspace example/ios/Example.xcworkspace \
            -scheme Example \
            -sdk iphonesimulator \
            -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15' \
            -only-testing:MetaAppLockTests \
            -enableCodeCoverage YES
      - name: Upload coverage
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ios-coverage
          path: ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/**/Logs/Test/*.xcresult

  js:
    name: JS/TS Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - name: Install deps
        run: npm ci
      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck
      - name: Jest
        run: npm test -- --coverage
      - name: Upload coverage
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: js-coverage
          path: coverage/

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint # react-native-meta-app-lock

Device-bound app lock for React Native with hardware-backed encryption, biometric unlock, logarithmic backoff, and trusted-location risk scoring.

## Features

| Feature | Implementation | Security Goal |

| **Failed Attempt Lockout** | `lockout_sec = 5 * log₂(failed_attempts + 1)` | Scales penalty: 1 fail = 5s, 7 fails = 15s, 15 fails = 20s. Stops bots, not users. |
| **Biometric** | `BiometricPrompt` / `LAContext.deviceOwnerAuthentication` | No face/fingerprint data leaves device. Falls back to device PIN. |
| **Auto-lock** | `SystemClock.elapsedRealtime` / `processUptime` vs user timeout | Immune to device clock changes. |
| **Trusted Location** | Risk = `log₁₀(wifi+1) + log₁₀(appSwitches+1) + log₁₀(hours+1) - 1.0 if SSID trusted` | Extends timeout at home, forces lock if risk > 1.3 |
| **Wipe on 10 Fails** | Deletes Keystore/Keychain key + AsyncStorage + cookies + web data | Cloned app or offline attack yields nothing. |

## Install

```bash

cd ios && pod install import { AppLock } from 'react-native-meta-app-lock';

await AppLock.setAutoLockTimeout(1);
await AppLock.setTrustedLocationConfig({
  enabled: true,

  riskThreshold: 1.3
});

// Check on app foreground

  // show <LockScreen />
}
